$comment: Import/export plugin registry. fmt reads this to dispatch and to build its help text. Add a format = drop a script + one entry here. See PLUGINS.md.

pnp-faces.desc: 3x3 PnP PDF -> local source-face references mapped by collector number

tts.desc: Tabletop Simulator / Dextrous / Screentop deck export -> game project (round-trips the TTS exporter)

playtest.desc: Ingest a play-session's results (loose JSON) -> schema-valid playtests/*.json, pinned to the tested version

project.desc: Forge design project -> three-way card/printing/template merge (dry-run unless --write)

nandeck-layout.desc: nanDECK layout -> field-level three-way merge into versioned Forge family/component YAML

pnpink.desc: PnPInk/Inkscape family working copy -> three-way card-data + SVG-source review

print.desc: Print-ready package (A4 + Letter duplex PDFs, 3.175mm bleed PNGs, press PDF)

tts.desc: Tabletop Simulator mod (sprite sheet + save JSON; carries provenance)

ttc.desc: Tabletop Club asset pack (open-source 3D playspace; carries provenance)

ttpg.desc: Tabletop Playground package (object templates + textures + staged .vts state; carries provenance)

vtt.desc: VirtualTabletop.io staged table (.vtt package + state JSON) from a versioned setup

project.desc: Portable design project: editable CSV + canonical JSON + templates/assets + merge baseline

nandeck.desc: Family-aware nanDECK project (MM scripts + CSV + explicit fidelity report)

pnpink.desc: Version-pinned PnPInk/Inkscape .pnp working copy for every configured card family

htmlcards.desc: HTML/CSS card sheet with a swappable theme (classic/minimal/foil); --png rasterizes faces via Chromium
